summary: Afrishop (customer-only Expo app) end-to-end tested. Backend reverse-proxy to africashop.win verified via pytest (9/9 PASSED including LIVE order placement). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390x844) verified: login (CLIENT role) → home with hero/categories/promotions/shops/products from live data → product detail (price, stock, shop) → add-to-cart (toast + badge) → cart (qty steppers, remove, Commander) → checkout → place-order (LIVE, writes real CMD- reference upstream) → success screen → My Orders listing shows the newly created order with real tracking refs (AM...). Account tab shows profile, wallet (XOF balance), orders/wallet links. Language switcher works for fr→en→es and updates ALL UI strings including tab bar. Logout returns to /login. Home search bar navigates to /products listing. Categories tab renders categories and shops. No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch found. Minor: Expo web warnings about shadow* and props.pointerEvents deprecation from third-party deps (phosphor-react-native/react-native-web) — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not thrown by app code — originates from library components; cosmetic in web preview, no runtime failure.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: proxy correctly preserves method/query/Authorization/body and strips hop-by-hop headers (incl. content-encoding, content-length) — good.
auth.tsx: CustomerOnlyError throws before persisting if user.role !== 'CLIENT' — correctly enforces customer-only policy.
checkout.tsx: body shape {items:[{product_id, qty}]} matches upstream contract (qty, not quantity).
config.ts: API_BASE derived from process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — no hardcoded URL.
server.py: MongoDB client is instantiated but never used (pure proxy). Not a bug; could be removed to reduce surface area.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Live orders were placed on africashop.win using the test customer (customer2@afrimarket.demo) as required by the problem statement. During testing a few CMD-XXXXXXXX orders were created on the real upstream (CMD-33894009, CMD-24773798, CMD-51868398).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is a pure reverse-proxy at /api/afm/* → https://africashop.win/api/*. Test customer: customer2@afrimarket.demo / Test@2026 (role CLIENT). Order body must use 'qty' not 'quantity'. Placing an order writes a REAL upstream order (expected by product requirement). Frontend tab routes are /, /categories, /cart, /account. Logout testID is 'account-logout-button'. Checkout testID is 'cart-checkout-button' (on cart tab), 'place-order-button' (on checkout screen).
